answer: The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. One plume proves a maker, one trellis proves a payment, one vertex proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Every applicant faces the same trial, Tile cutter rust red proof glazed at the packing room, and every verdict reads the same way: each rust red is a tile count weighed beside the makers mark. Stake 4 times the reward and the farm must park 75460 POA to chase 490 seats it will likely never win.
